body:
Redline round 3

Final nit pass: reviewed only the nit fixes (37c22f9..a327e96) for correctness bugs they introduced.

The round 2 fixes land as decided: both manifests parse and read 0.2.1, no shipped file, doc, test or standard still names 0.2.0, the CHANGELOG heading moved with them, and the bypass-permissions sentence now sits after the probe, so "in both" again means the two launches. This diff introduces no correctness bug. It touches only two manifests, the CHANGELOG and one standard, and this repository has no `routes/console.php`, so no scheduled command or queued job overlaps it.

No findings.

### For the person

- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json:4` · R2-1's decision has the PR description's version sentence redrafted by hand, but its opening line also says "the installed-release walk after the 0.2.0 tag", and 0.2.0 is now never tagged, so that line needs the same edit to 0.2.1.
